source_format: PCM16 LE, 24000 Hz, 2 channels interleaved. Evidence: the byte count equals exactly the requested duration as stereo, and the two channels correlate at 0.999+ (duplicated mono).
processing: Channels averaged to mono; trimmed below -45 dB of peak with 2 ms preroll and 12 ms tail; capped; 2 ms fade in, 8 ms fade out; peak normalised to -12 dBFS.
licence: Provider output. Not covered by the repository MIT licence; git-ignored and bundled only in releases.

control_lost.prompt: One soft low descending two-note tone signalling that control is taken away. Short, gentle, dry, instant onset, silence afterwards. Nonverbal isolated mono user interface sound. No voice, no music, no background, no reverb.

sneak_spotted.prompt: One short sharp rising two-note alert tone, urgent, signalling you have just been seen. Dry, instant onset, silence afterwards. Nonverbal isolated mono user interface sound. No voice, no music, no background, no reverb.

sneak_hidden.prompt: One soft calm low single tone that settles, signalling you are safely out of sight again. Gentle, dry, instant onset, silence afterwards. Nonverbal isolated mono user interface sound. No voice, no music, no background, no reverb.

focus_tick_a.prompt: A single soft dry wooden click, like one notch of a wooden dial turning. Very short, instant onset, no tail. Nonverbal isolated mono user interface sound. No voice, no music, no background, no reverb.

focus_tick_b.prompt: A single bright crisp high metallic tick, like a tiny bell-like click of a camera lens ring. Very short, instant onset, no tail. Nonverbal isolated mono user interface sound. No voice, no music, no background, no reverb.
